      "rationale": "The work boundary was not released (maintenance acceptance signature missing) and no line opening was authorized. This condition allowed the interruption to occur without a formal isolation procedure or barrier verification.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1","24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],
      "claimIds": ["finding-1hfd1r1", "claim-ojcuoi"],
      "counterfactual": "If the maintenance acceptance signature had been signed and a line opening authorized, would an interruption have occurred?",
      "competingExplanation": "The interruption could be due to upstream supply failure unrelated to boundary status.",
      "evidenceGap": "No evidence links the lack of authorization directly to the cause of the air loss; correlation does not prove causation."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-16kxawb",
      "toKey": "n-1lq9li6",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The lack of line opening authorization and the absence of a released boundary meant that valve positions were not verified. The area directory does not establish valve states or pressure availability at any given time.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1","b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"],
      "claimIds": ["finding-jkn4le", "claim-ivbspk"],
      "counterfactual": "If valve positions had been verified via a current diagram or field check, would the interruption have been prevented?",
      "competingExplanation": "The area directory limitation is procedural; it does not explain why pressure dropped.",
      "evidenceGap": "No evidence of actual valve state at time of incident."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1lq9li6",
      "toKey": "n-2jmrrk",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The area directory does not establish valve positions or pressure availability. This condition contributed to the lack of awareness about potential supply changes.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If a current piping diagram had been used, would the interruption have been prevented?",
      "competingExplanation": "The directory limitation is inherent to its design; it does not explain why pressure dropped.",
      "evidenceGap": "No evidence of actual valve state at time of incident."
    }
  ],
  "decision": {
    "summary": "Three edges were proposed: (1) lack of boundary release caused no line opening authorization, (2) no line opening contributed to reliance on an inadequate area directory that does not show valve states or pressure availability, and (3) the directory limitation itself is a condition but does not explain why pressure dropped. All three are supported by evidence regarding procedural gaps and document limitations.",
    "evidenceUsed": ["eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1", "b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1", "24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],
    "unknowns": ["Actual valve state at time of interruption.", "Whether an unrecorded service-routing change occurred."],
    "alternatives": ["Upstream supply failure unrelated to boundary status or directory limitations."],
    "confidence": 0.65
  },
  "evidenceRequests": [
    "Request a record showing the actual valve state at RHOB receiving header H-R at approximately 10:00 on May 20, 2024.",
    "Request evidence of any service-routing changes affecting instrument-air supply between April and May 2024."
  ]
}
